title: laothoe leichtlinii
intro: Laothoe leichtlinii, commonly known as the Lesser Swallow Prominent, is actually the larvae of a moth species, not typically classified as a plant. However, if we consider the plant that the moth larvae feed on, it's often a plant in the genus Lathraea, like Lathraea squamaria. Lathraea squamaria, commonly known as the Yellow Toothwort or Yellow Lathraea, is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. The health benefits of Lathraea squamaria include its potential antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions like wound healing and antioxidant activities.
